{
  "jobspec": "#!/bin/bash

# Flux batch script
#
# This is a self-submitting Flux script: run it directly (e.g., `./meta_TCT_simulations.flux.sh`).
# It will submit itself to Flux with the translated resource requests.

# Translated resources from Slurm:
#   --ntasks=1 --cpus-per-task=72 -> -n 1 -c 72
#   --time=09:00:00               -> -t 9h
JOBID=$(flux batch -N 1 -n 1 -c 72 -t 9h --wrap "bash $0 __flux_inner")

echo "Submitted Flux job: $JOBID"

if [ "${1:-}" = "__flux_inner" ]; then
  # NOTE: Slurm --job-name=meta-TCT-simulations not translated.
  # Performance/ops implication: job identification may be less convenient; runtime performance is unaffected.

  # NOTE: Slurm --cluster=wice not translated.
  # Performance implication: without a site-specific cluster/queue mapping, the job may run on different resources, affecting performance.

  # NOTE: Slurm --mail-type=BEGIN,END,FAIL not translated.
  # Performance implication: none; operational implication: no email notifications.

  # NOTE: Slurm -A lp_doctoralresearch not translated.
  # Performance/ops implication: accounting/charging may not be applied as intended; site may require account/project out-of-band.

  export OMP_NUM_THREADS=1

  module use /apps/leuven/rocky8/icelake/2022b/modules/all
  module load GSL
  module load CMake
  module load R/4.3.2-foss-2022b

  flux run -n 1 -c 72 Rscript -e "renv::restore()" -e "Sys.setenv(TZ='Europe/Brussels')"
  flux run -n 1 -c 72 Rscript colorectal-sensitivity-analysis-relaxed.R 71
fi
"
}
